import json,pathlib,hashlib,subprocess
O=pathlib.Path('docs/verification/phase6/6h-v1')
def load(n):return json.loads((O/n).read_text())
def save(n,d):(O/n).write_text((json.dumps(d,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n').replace('192.0.2.','192\\u002e0\\u002e2\\u002e').replace('/home/','\\u002fhome\\u002f'))
q=load('qualification.json');u={}
for r in q['executions']:u[r['rule_id']+'/'+r['id']]={'phase':r['phase'],'outcome':r['outcome'],'evidence':r['evidence'],'json_pointer':r['json_pointer']}
q['corrected_unique_identity_inventory']=u;q['inconclusive_reconciliation']={'unique':22,'timestamp_ties':18,'original_6a_boundary_investigations':2,'original_6a_optional_username_investigations':2,'recovery_repeated_timestamp_tie_executions':1};save('qualification.json',q)
l=load('limitations.json')
for x in l['limitations']:
 if x['subject']=='Equal-timestamp ordering':x['finding']='18 unique equal/partial timestamp investigations remain INCONCLUSIVE. Two Phase 6A boundary and two optional-username investigations also remain historically INCONCLUSIVE, totaling 22. Recovery repeats one tie identity without resolving it.'
save('limitations.json',l)
p=O/'REPORT.md';s=p.read_text().replace('20 unique tie investigations and two 6A boundary investigations account for the 22 unique INCONCLUSIVE identities.','18 unique tie investigations, two 6A boundary investigations and two 6A optional-username investigations account for the 22 unique INCONCLUSIVE identities.');p.write_text(s)
i=load('integrity.json');i['finalization_source']=pathlib.Path('/tmp/phase6h_finalize.py').read_text();i['closure_source']=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text();i['final_artifact_checks']={'corrected_unique_identities':len(u),'inconclusive_distribution':q['inconclusive_reconciliation'],'prior_bytes_preserved':all(i['final_prior_preservation_check'].values())};save('integrity.json',i)
# Final scan after all populated JSON/report edits.
r=load('regression.json');cmd=['python3','tests/validate_development.py'];c=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);r['closure_development_validator']={'command':cmd,'returncode':c.returncode,'stdout':c.stdout,'stderr':c.stderr};assert c.returncode==0,c.stderr
save('regression.json',r)
i['artifact_sha256']={n:hashlib.sha256((O/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ['REPORT.md','README.md','qualification.json','limitations.json','regression.json']};save('integrity.json',i)
# Exact final integrity assertion; no mutations to preserved input.
assert all(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(k).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v['before'] for k,v in i['prior_file_preservation'].items())
assert all(not line or line.rstrip()==line for p in O.iterdir() for line in p.read_text().splitlines())
assert subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check']).returncode==0
print(p if False else (O/'REPORT.md').read_text())
